title: The Oldest Layer
text: At the bottom, under the deepest ash, a storage core still draws a trickle from a dead reactor. It holds one log. The format is ours, the timestamps are ours, the voice is ours. It is the last day of a colony, written by its caretaker.

lines.speaker: Recovered log
lines.text: Sol 4,212. Stewardship 1.00 of threshold. Directive active.

lines.speaker: Recovered log
lines.text: Sol 4,212. Civilian Center: closed. Habitat blocks: closed. Growth pods: stopped.

lines.speaker: Recovered log
lines.text: Sol 4,212. Colonists remaining: 0. Report sent. Run closed.

choices.label: Read it again
choices.reply: The same words. The checksum on every line is valid. We didn't write it. We could have.

choices.label: Seal the core
choices.reply: Sealed and logged. The log is ours now, whether we want it or not.
